highlights: Jozapi fork：保住【】裡的文字。muse.ai 會把【…】當成引用標記刪掉，提示詞改用同形括號〖〗送出，回覆再換回【】（MUSE2API_PROTECT_BRACKETS=0 可關閉）。
Jozapi fork：修正對話回覆在 muse.ai 重新渲染時被重複輸出（截斷的一份 + 完整的一份），非串流請求改回傳最終文字，串流不再整段重送。
Jozapi fork：修正對話回覆早已寫完卻一直等到 chat_timeout（300 秒）才失敗。muse.ai 任務列表裡其他任務的「Stop task」按鈕不再被當成本輪仍在生成。
合入上游 1.6.12：修复 #62，muse.ai 从 2026-11-19 起聊天里只显示约 498px 的缩略图，生成的图片因此变小。现在图片任务会打开 muse.ai 的图片查看器取原图（实测 1344x1792），取不到时仍返回缩略图并在日志里提示。只影响图片任务；视频、对话与参考素材上传不变。无需再升级浏览器插件。
合入上游 1.6.11：修复工作区暂未分配时丢弃新 Cookie 的问题；保存轮换后的登录态，但不把未确认会话标成成功。
合入上游 1.6.11：浏览器插件升级至 1.0.3：按当前普通/无痕窗口读取 Cookie，避免导入另一个窗口的账号；找不到存储区时停止导入。
合入上游 1.6.11：图片和视频采用独立排队时限（默认 3600 秒，0 为不限）；排队不消耗生成预算，失败记录保留账号、尝试次数和原始错误。
合入上游 1.6.11：检查更新只读：如实区分本地版本/提交与远端状态；有更新时提醒，由管理员手动确认升级，任务排队或运行期间拒绝更新。
合入上游 1.6.11：媒体库只加载视频缩略图，点击后才加载所选视频，关闭预览释放播放器；源部署需 FFmpeg，Docker 用户请重建镜像。
合入上游 1.6.11：组合修复聊天与媒体的资源获取顺序、排队设置跨域 PUT 和固定提交版本读取；继续保留独立代理、轮询及会话健康检查。
合入上游 1.6.11：请先更新服务，再手动升级插件 1.0.3：替换原目录并重新加载；每个浏览器个人资料分别升级，无痕模式还需允许扩展运行。油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2。
更新檢測改用上游 1.6.11 的只讀檢查與手動確認升級，並預設追蹤 Jozapi/muse2api（可用 MUSE2API_REPOSITORY 或 MUSE2API_REPO 覆寫），升級不會被上游覆蓋 fork 的修正。
highlights_en: Jozapi fork: keep text inside 【】. muse.ai deletes 【…】 as citation markers; prompts now travel with look-alike brackets 〖〗 and replies get 【】 back (MUSE2API_PROTECT_BRACKETS=0 turns it off).

Jozapi fork: chat replies are no longer duplicated when muse.ai re-renders them (a cut-off copy followed by the full one). Non-streaming requests return the final text; streaming never resends the whole answer.

Jozapi fork: finished chat replies no longer wait for the full chat_timeout (300 s) and then fail. A "Stop task" button from another task in muse.ai's task list no longer counts as this reply still generating.

Merged upstream 1.6.12: Fix #62. Since 2026-11-19 muse.ai shows only a ~498px thumbnail in the chat, so generated images came back small. Image tasks now open muse.ai's image viewer and return the full-size picture (measured 1344x1792); if it cannot be opened the thumbnail is still returned and a warning is logged. Images only; video, chat and reference uploads are unchanged. No further extension upgrade is needed.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: Preserve cookies rotated by unassigned-workspace responses without marking an unconfirmed session healthy.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: Extension 1.0.3 reads the active regular/incognito window cookie store and stops instead of importing from another store when identification fails.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: Image/video queue waits have a separate budget (3600 seconds by default; 0 means unlimited). Failed tasks retain account, attempt and original error.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: Update checks are read-only and report installed provenance separately. Updates notify administrators and require explicit confirmation; queued/running work blocks upgrades.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: The media library lazily loads video thumbnails and requests a video only on playback. Source deployments need FFmpeg; Docker users should rebuild images.
Merged upstream 1.6.11: Integration fixes align chat/media resource acquisition, allow queue-setting PUT preflights and bind remote version metadata to one commit.

Merged upstream 1.6.11: Update the service, then manually upgrade extension 1.0.3 in every browser profile by replacing files and reloading. Allow the extension in Incognito/InPrivate when needed. Userscript remains 1.1.2.

Update checks now use upstream 1.6.11's read-only check with explicit upgrade confirmation, tracking Jozapi/muse2api by default (override with MUSE2API_REPOSITORY or MUSE2API_REPO) so an upgrade cannot overwrite the fork's fixes.
